    🪐 Leonidas¶

    [!INFO] A256 #1 — Rocky, Venus-like — 1 moons — 0.72 AU Scorched, thick CO₂, pressure high. Venus-analog but with 1 captured moon (Venus has none — suggests capture, not formation). Hot enough to soften talon-cut iron.

    🌌 Orbit around Golias¶

    Parameter Value
    System [[A256/index
    Star Golias — G1V, 1.08 M⊙, 1.55 L⊙, 5,880K, ~4.7 Gyr
    Semi-major axis 0.72 AU
    Period ~225 Earth days (~208 Ge'or days)
    Type Rocky, Venus-like
    Moons 1 — Leonidas Moon — 1 unnamed
    Ring No

    Inner rocky, just inside habitable zone. Proofs Golias is luminous — at 0.72 AU, Leonidas gets ~3× Ge'or flux.

    Estimated via Kepler from Ge'or fixed year (520 Earth days at 1.26 AU) and spacing consistent with your order. Not handwaved — derived.
